name: Amit Gautam Memorial Scholarship (B.Tech in Electronics Engineering – 4th Year)
benefit: The eligible student will receive ₹7,000/- per year as a scholarship.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 4th year of the B.Tech (Electronics Engineering) course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of one year only.
